title: Reduction of a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Fee for Credit Already Given on the Line
content:
The credit already given on the line is then taken off, because a line the retailer has already credited for its own failure does not then carry the full charge for putting the stock back. Where the credits already recorded against the line come to the material credit amount or more, the large credit reduction is taken off. Where they come to less than that but to more than nothing, the small credit reduction is taken off. In any other case nothing is taken off.

The material credit amount is 25.00 USD. The large credit reduction is 20.00 USD. The small credit reduction is 10.00 USD.

## What is read

The credits read are the credits already recorded against that order line on Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment, taken together as one sum. That sum is what the reduction of the Northbeam Returns and Restocking fee turns on.

| The credits already recorded against the line, taken together | Amount taken off |
| --- | --- |
| 25.00 USD or more | 20.00 USD |
| more than nothing but less than 25.00 USD | 10.00 USD |
| nothing | nothing |

## Both sides of the threshold, on hypothetical inputs

*Credits against the line coming to 25.00 USD.* Twenty-five is 25.00 USD or more, so 20.00 USD is taken off.

*Credits against the line coming to 24.99 USD.* That is less than 25.00 USD and more than nothing, so 10.00 USD is taken off.

*Two credits against the line, of 15.00 USD and 12.00 USD.* Taken together they come to 27.00 USD, which is 25.00 USD or more, so 20.00 USD is taken off; the reduction turns on the sum and not on either credit by itself.

*Credits against the line coming to 0.01 USD.* That is more than nothing, so 10.00 USD is taken off.

*No credit recorded against the line at all.* Nothing is taken off.
